subject: [PATCH 1/6] libdaxctl: add dax kmem atomic hotplug state accessors

2026-10-16.patch_summary: This patch adds support for atomic whole-device hotplug to the libdaxctl library by introducing an enum and getter/setter functions for accessing the /sys/bus/dax/devices/daxX.Y/state attribute. The new functionality allows users to determine the state of a dax device, such as whether it is online or offline, and set its state accordingly. This patch is part of a larger series that aims to enhance the libdaxctl library with features related to hotplug and memory management.

reviews.author: Alison Schofield
reviews.summary: Applied the Reviewed-by tag without any comments or concerns.
reviews.raw_body:
On Fri, Oct 16, 2026 at 05:42:43PM -0400, Gregory Price (Meta) wrote:
> From: Gregory Price <gourry@gourry.net>
> 
> Recent kernels add /sys/bus/dax/devices/daxX.Y/state to dax_kmem
> devices for atomic whole-device hotplug. It reads 'unplugged',
> 'offline', 'online', 'online_kernel' or 'online_movable', and accepts
> all but 'offline'.
> 
> Add an enum and get/set accessors for it. The getter returns
> DAXCTL_KMEM_UNKNOWN when the attribute is absent, so callers can fall
> back to per-block operations.


Reviewed-by: Alison Schofield <alison.schofield@intel.com>

2026-10-21.patch_summary: This patch series adds support for atomic whole-device hotplug to the libdaxctl library, which is used by the Linux kernel's device management system. It introduces a new enum and accessors for getting and setting the kmem state of dax devices, allowing callers to fall back to per-block operations when the attribute is absent. The patch also includes updates to the libdaxctl-private.h header file.
